in_marathi.name: Parin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parin comes from the Sanskrit word ‘pari’ meaning ‘over’ or ‘above’ and ‘n’ meaning ‘lord’ or ‘master’. This name is often given to a child born under the belief that they will grow up to be a leader, a protector, or a wise ruler.
